 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 38.4 W Arafat Minhas to Sonny Baker, out Gus Atkinson Run Out!! 1 run completed. A direct hit from Arafat Minhas and think Gus Atkinson is OUT - the 3rd umpire isn't needed and Pakistan win by 87 runs. An awful mix-up draws curtains on the game for England. Was tossed up on middle and drifted onto the pads - flicked in front of square on the on-side and they completed the first run. The fun then started - Gus Atkinson was rushing back for the second, Sonny Baker started and then turned back, the throw was at the bowler's end. Minhas grabbed and dropped the ball, Gus Atkinson tried to rush back - but Minhas recovered quickly, collected the ball and threw down the stumps at the striker's end, catching the batter well short. Gus Atkinson run out (Arafat Minhas) 7(5) [4s-1] 38.3 Arafat Minhas to Sonny Baker, no run, tossed up on middle and leg, defended back at the bowler 38.2 W Arafat Minhas to Adil Rashid, out Lbw!! That looks straight and Minhas has his 6th wicket. Adil Rashid was walking back to the pavilion, but he then turns around and decides to chance his luck. This looked plumb though - tossed up and sliding into the right-hander - Rashid pressed forward and then played down the wrong line, struck bang in front of middle and on the knee-roll. No bat and we're through to ball-tracking: It's hitting the top of middle and leg - three reds and Sharfuddoula Saikat's original call stays. Minhas finds himself on a hat-trick now. Adil Rashid lbw b Arafat Minhas 0(1) 38.1 W Arafat Minhas to Will Jacks, out Caught by Shaheen Afridi!! Five wickets for Minhas and he's on cloud nine - dropped short and Jacks swivelled across on the pull, but it's not short enough - no elevation as the ball hit high on the bat and it's a simple catch for the Pakistani captain at mid-wicket. A 50 earlier in the day and he now has 5 wickets as well. Will Jacks c Shaheen Afridi b Arafat Minhas 19(24) [4s-1 6s-1] 36.6 Arafat Minhas to Will Jacks, no run, Minhas tosses one just outside off - punched off the back-foot to backward point 36.5 Arafat Minhas to Gus Atkinson, 1 run, tossed up and drifting onto the pads, Atkinson gets inside the line on the flick - to the right of short fine, the fielder dives to make a half-stop 36.4 W Arafat Minhas to Jamie Overton, out Caught by Hasan Nawaz!! A miscue and Overton has holed out to long-on - 4th wicket for Arafat Minhas, he's having a superb match - Overton came down the pitch, was completely undone in the flight, went through with the lofted drive. The ball came off the inside half and lobbed into the hands of a sliding Hassan Nawaz at long-on. Jamie Overton c Hasan Nawaz b Arafat Minhas 1(4) 36.3 Arafat Minhas to Jamie Overton, no run, tossed up on off, pushed back at the bowler 36.2 Arafat Minhas to Will Jacks, 1 run, dropped short and wide of off, cut away square past cover for a single 36.1 4 Arafat Minhas to Will Jacks, FOUR , crunched , fraction short and at the stumps - Jacks picks the length early, swivels across and then hammers the pull over wide mid-wicket for a boundary 34.6 Arafat Minhas to Jamie Overton, no run, pushed through on off, punched back at the bowler 34.5 W Arafat Minhas to Jordan Cox, out Lbw!! A big shout and Jordan Cox has been given OUT LBW, Was this drifting down leg? It has been reviewed - was tossed up and slid back into the right-hander, Cox was pressing forward on the drive and is beaten on the inside edge. Did it straighten enough? Or was it sliding with the angle? Ball-tracking: It's going on with the angle and hitting the leg-stump - three reds, Cox is OUT and he takes a review with him as well. Jordan Cox lbw b Arafat Minhas 18(16) [4s-1 6s-1] 34.4 Arafat Minhas to Will Jacks, 1 run, Minhas tosses one wider of off, driven in front of square on the off-side for a single 34.3 Arafat Minhas to Jordan Cox, 1 run, tossed up just outside off - punched off the back-foot to deep cover for a single 34.2 6 Arafat Minhas to Jordan Cox, SIX , clubbed , they're finding the boundaries now - wasn't all that short, but Cox goes back and then drags the pull overv wide mid-wicket, the timing was sweet and the ball sailed away 34.1 Arafat Minhas to Will Jacks, 1 run, flighted delivery outside off - Jacks makes room and cuts it square on the off-side for a single 29.6 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 1 run, Minhas floats one around off, eased down to long-on for a single 29.5 Arafat Minhas to Jordan Cox, 1 run, tossed up just outside off - driven down to long-off for a single 29.4 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 1 run, fraction short and on off - Cox goes back and works it down to long-on for a single 29.3 Arafat Minhas to Jordan Cox, 1 run, Minhas tosses one on the leg-stump line, clipped wide of mid-wicket for a single 29.2 Arafat Minhas to Jordan Cox, no run, tossed up on middle, punched back at the bowler - Arafat fumbles and has to run back, Cox thinks about a single and is sent back 29.1 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 1 run, flatter and on off, punched off the back-foot to long-on 26.6 Arafat Minhas to Joe Root, no run, tossed upon middle and leg, punched back at the bowler 26.5 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 1 run, flighted delivery on off, punched off the back-foot to long-on for a run 26.4 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 2 runs, fraction short and wide of off - Curran backs away and cuts it in front of square on the off-side, comes back for the second run 26.3 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, no run, Minhas tosses one just outside off - defended back at the bowler 26.2 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, no run, flighted delivery outside off - a press forward as Curran defended 26.1 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, no run, Arafat tosses one just outside off - Curran leans across defensively 24.6 Arafat Minhas to Joe Root, no run, tossed up delivery, outside off, driven down to cover 24.5 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 1 run, short, wide, slashed down to deep cover for a single 24.4 Arafat Minhas to Joe Root, 1 run, well doled up, pushed down to deep cover for a single 24.3 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 1 run, nudges the ball down to long leg for a single as it spun in 24.2 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, no run, flatter one, outside off, Sam Curran misses the chop 24.1 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, no run, tossed up delivery, turning in, Sam Curran nudges the ball down to mid-wicket 22.6 Arafat Minhas to Joe Root, 1 run, angled in, on the pads, tucked down to fine leg for a single 22.5 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 1 run, plays that down to mid-on for a single as it spun in 22.4 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, no run, flatter one, angled in, nudged down to mid-wicket 22.3 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, no run, tucked back to the bowler as that was a flatter one 22.2 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, no run, tossed up delivery, tucked down to mid-wicket 22.1 Arafat Minhas to Joe Root, 3 runs, tossed up delivery, on the sticks, reverse paddles it fine for a triple 20.6 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 1 run, tossed up delivery, turning in, nudged down to long-on for a single 20.5 Arafat Minhas to Joe Root, 1 run, defends it down into the off-side with soft hands for a single 20.4 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, 1 run, tossed up delivery, clipped down to long-on for a single 20.3 Arafat Minhas to Sam Curran, no run, tossed up delivery, turning in, nudged down to mid-wicket 20.2 W Arafat Minhas to Harry Brook, out Bowled!! And a rippah! That turned a lot and beat the poke off the back foot. That was a tossed up delivery, turned away and Harry Brook went back to play it but missed the line of the delivery owing to the turn. Massive moment in the game. The dangerous Harry Brook has to go. Arafat Minhas is all charged up. He lets out a roar. Harry Brook b Arafat Minhas 5(7) 20.1 Arafat Minhas to Joe Root, 1 run, plays that down to sweeper cover for a single 18.6 Arafat Minhas to Harry Brook, 1 run, angled in, nudged wide of mid-wicket for a single 18.5 Arafat Minhas to Harry Brook, no run, nudges the ball down as that was angled in 18.4 Arafat Minhas to Harry Brook, no run, stabs it down into the off-side 18.3 W Arafat Minhas to Tom Banton, out Caught by Shaheen Afridi!! Pulled down to mid-wicket. That was a flatter one, Tom Banton goes back to pull it and taken by the man inside the circle. That was hit hard but straight to the fielder. Easy one.
